chunks: And Abraham left this legacy to his sons, and to Jacob, and said: 'O my sons, God has chosen this as the faith for you. Do not die but as those who have submitted (to God).'
ai.seo_question: What did Abraham instruct his sons regarding their faith and death?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the continuity of the divine covenant (‘Ahd) through the Imams, who are seen as the inheritors of Abraham’s and Jacob’s pure monotheism. It underscores that 'Islam' here denotes the eternal religion of submission to God’s will, a state of being that believers must preserve until their final breath, linking the patriarchal lineage to the broader community of the faithful.
